title: Chapter 140
text:
On the Tedramira River, a fierce battle was going on.

Hesla was in charge of sealing off the sea. A naval formation was stationed at the estuary. Most of them were battleships equipped with large caliber naval cannons. They bombarded the Germinal Organization fleet from a distance of more than ten kilometers. The flames from the cannons could be fired more than ten meters away. The high-speed cannons drew a parabola in the night sky and caused a lot of damage to the Germinal Organization fleet.

The destroyers in the formation fired a few cruise missiles at the beginning of the battle, but they were all intercepted by the Germinal Organization fleet's cannons in mid-air. They stopped firing and were on standby to maintain the blockade.

The command ship, the Flying Blade, was in the center of the formation.

"The enemy is still twelve kilometers away from the mine formation at the estuary. Don't give the enemy time to resolve the trap. Stag, Red Fish, and Short-tailed Shark are loaded with torpedoes in advance. Once the Germinal Organization fleet enters the sea, launch the torpedoes and let them eat their fill. The battleship formation, maintain the current attack strength and do not change. Sonar detection, pay attention to the surrounding sea area. Germinal Organization reinforcements may appear. Inform Stardragon to release some ground troops to delay the arrival of the Germinal Organization's naval forces. Tell Stardragon's commander that we need their assault force at any time! "The Hesla commander on the Flying Blade assigned the tasks in an orderly manner.

On the other side, the fighter jets that took off from the nearby military base were diligently harassing the Germinal Organization fleet. They mainly bombarded the Germinal Organization fleet and caused a lot of trouble. There were always some lucky cannons that passed through the intercepting array of the naval cannons. Three ships were blown up like that. The main purpose of the fleet was to evacuate, so their weapons were not standard enough to lock onto the high-speed fighter jets, let alone kill them.

But the Germinal Organization had its own way!

A fighter jet that swept across the sky emptied another wave of ammunition. The pilot was about to turn around and do it again when a cloud of black fog suddenly exploded beside him. A shadow appeared out of thin air. It was a demonic man with eyeshadow and earrings. He held a sharp blade in his hand and quickly slit the pilot's throat. Blood splattered on the window.

The fighter jet fell with the pilot's corpse. The demonic man smiled coldly and disappeared again, leaving behind a cloud of black fog.

Teleportation ability! Germinal Organization Executive Officer Renette.

On a barge, Hella stepped onto the bow. The sea breeze with the smell of smoke blew her slightly curly red hair. She took a deep breath and raised her hands high as if she was praising the sun. Wisps of gray air escaped from the fresh corpses on the battlefield, gathered from all directions, and seeped into Hella's face.

Her face immediately flushed red as if she had just taken in a divine drug. She closed her eyes slightly and then opened them abruptly. An invisible sound wave rose from her lungs to her throat as she blurted out.

"Ahhh!"

It was shrill and ear-piercing, like the shrieks of ghosts!

The eyeballs of all the pilots of the fighter jets above the fleet exploded at the same time. Blood spurted out of their ears, and their brains turned into a pile of paste. The fighter jets fell one after another like kites with their strings cut. They crashed into the ground and the river and exploded into balls of fire.

A no-fly zone was formed in the sky, and a fighter jet formation was destroyed by Hella alone! The remaining fighter jets received the order and hurriedly retreated!

This was the terrifying power of a military-level Esper. A weapon that required a person to control. If the controller was too weak, Hella's Power of the Dead could directly attack the mind. Blue Star's technology tree did not have much technology to deal with mind attacks.

Only a few reconnaissance drones continued to track and observe in the sky.

Renette teleported to Hella's side. He painfully covered his head with one hand, and blood flowed out of his nose. With a cold expression, he shouted, "Do you want to kill me too?"

Hella's face was cold and did not answer. Renette could only swallow his anger. He did not dare to provoke Hella.

In the command room, Lin Yu was watching the battle without blinking. He looked at his watch and said, "It's about time."

The Germinal Organization's ground forces had broken through the blockade and were rapidly approaching the designated landing site. Stardragon's army had followed the plan and held back a little so that the naval forces could be delayed. When the ground forces boarded the ships, Hesla would be able to deal with them. In a naval battle, the ground forces would not be of much use. In fact, they would be a burden to reduce losses and weaken the enemy.

The naval formation's destroyers had a new type of missile that could cruise and split apart to avoid intercepting formations. As long as the Germinal Organization's ground forces connected, they would immediately launch the missile. One round would be enough to severely damage the Germinal Organization's fleet. Then, while the Germinal Organization was in a mess, the assault troops of Stardragon's Division 13 could board the ships and kill them.

This was the next step of the plan.

However, the plan could never keep up with the changes. Accidents always happened unexpectedly.

"Beep, beep, beep!" A piercing alarm sounded on Hesla's command ship. The radar detected dozens of targets approaching at high speed underwater.

Ghostly torpedoes!

Where did they come from?

There was no time to intercept them. The warships near the estuary exploded, and flames soared into the sky!

The higher-ups of Hesla had been paying attention to the battle. The attack on the naval formation made them extremely angry.

"Anti-sonar submarine? Why is the buoy not moving? How far is the enemy's range? "

This could only be the Germinal Organization's submarine. Where did it come from? Could it be that the Germinal Organization had sent them from Andrea and had set off early? Or could there be a secret base of the Germinal Organization nearby?

No matter what the reason was, the enemy had reinforcements. They had to deal with the unexpected situation!

"Where are our submarines?" Hesla's officers roared. They had deployed a few submarines nearby as insurance and immediately moved to find the enemy's submarines.

The naval formation had suffered heavy losses and was temporarily busy with emergency repairs. Naturally, the prepared missile attack could not continue. This caused a strategic break, and the situation was out of control.

The Germinal Organization's fleet seized this opportunity and changed their formation. The barges sailed close to the shore, opened the mouth of the barges, and lowered the gangplanks to provide a bridge for the ground forces to pass by the merchant ships. The gangplanks rubbed against the sand on the shore, leaving sharp marks. This way, there was a risk of running aground. The other ships threw out cable hooks to connect the barges. Even if the barges ran aground, they could be pulled back to the surface of the river at any time.

Lin Yu's confidence came from the submarine team. They were the reinforcements that the Germinal Organization had sent out early on. With this surprise attack, they had broken Hesla's blockade and strategic layout!

In order to break through Stardragon's ambush, Ugar had lost more than half of his troops. Seeing that the opportunity had come, he immediately ordered the fleet to speed up and rush onto the barges.

The Stardragon assault team that was on standby became anxious. According to the plan, Hesla would launch a round of missiles first, then they would rush up. If this was not part of the plan, they would only be targeted by the fleet if they rushed up rashly!

"What should we do?"

If they waited any longer and the Germinal Organization's fleet successfully connected, they would have no chance at all.

The assault team was made up of Stardragon's Division 13 agents and elite soldiers. They listened to the orders of their superiors with only one word.

"Go!"

Without any hesitation, the assault boats rushed out one by one. The Germinal Organization's fleet focused their fire on them immediately. The assault team charged head-on against the cannon fire. Waves kept exploding around them. Some of their comrades fell into the water and died, but it did not shake their morale or slow them down.
